summary: All requested repetitions traverse the complete distributed CSR matrix; no work-count omission identified.

source_evidence.claim: Root parses and broadcasts the requested iteration count unchanged. Remainder-aware rowRange covers every row; local delimiters and values/columns cover each partition. The timed outer loop calls the full local CSR kernel on every iteration.

compiled_evidence.claim: Between the two MPI_Wtime calls, mul/add at a0ad/a0b6 lie inside the nonzero loop; a0cc returns to the next row and a0d2 returns to a060 for the next requested iteration. The arithmetic is not hoisted out of the repetition loop.
